authorization: FLOWER_CELLS_MULTICLASS_2026-09-22: one user-declared HAR561 alternative after the CTG accuracy diagnostic failed; original CTG protocol and evidence remain unchanged.

dataset.name: UCI Human Activity Recognition Using Smartphones (561 engineered features)
dataset.citation: Anguita D, Ghio A, Oneto L, Parra X, Reyes-Ortiz JL. (2013). A Public Domain Dataset for Human Activity Recognition Using Smartphones. ESANN 2013.
dataset.license: UCI landing page: CC BY 4.0; historical archive README separately states noncommercial use and required citation.
dataset.target: 1 WALKING, 2 WALKING_UPSTAIRS, 3 WALKING_DOWNSTAIRS, 4 SITTING, 5 STANDING, 6 LAYING
dataset.cohort: All 10299 engineered-feature windows from 30 subjects; 7352 official training windows and 2947 official held-out windows; all 561 features in official order, named feature_001 through feature_561; no exclusions, subsampling or feature selection.
dataset.relationship_to_sequence: Same collection as sequence track; this cell uses engineered feature vectors, not raw inertial windows.

split.type: Official subject-disjoint train/test split; 21 training subjects, 9 held-out subjects. For each seed, shuffle sorted training subjects with R sample and assign consecutive groups of seven to three sites.
split.seed_scope: Subject-to-site partition and central initialization only. Generic federated Torch initialization and node cryptographic DP randomness retain release behavior; published seeds do not fully reproduce federated fits.

bounds_policy: Declared public bounds [-1,1] for every feature, from official archive README. Clip and affine-scale identically in central and released federated preprocessing. No data-derived bounds.
released_patient_semantics: Unchanged dsFlower 0.5.0 generic patient path clips/transforms each window to public bounds, averages features within subject, selects the modal class (smallest class breaks ties), then applies DP-SGD clipping to each pooled subject. Thus 7 effective training units/site and 21 overall, not gradients of all window losses grouped by subject. Central reference is trained on all official training windows; it shares split/model family/bounds but not this pooling.

training.parameters: All pytorch_multiclass v0.5.0 optimization defaults: linear softmax, SGD, learning_rate 0.1, batch_size 32, local_epochs 1, no scheduler, no regularization. Sole schema override n_classes=6 for six public activities.
training.privacy: patient unit with subject column, clipping norm 1, replace-one adjacency; per-node per-training epsilon 1/4/8, delta 1e-6. Seven pooled subjects and batch size32 imply full-unit sampling and one update/round.
training.inner_validation: None; no optimization search, validation split or post-score changes.

central: Unregularized multinomial logistic regression (nnet::multinom decay=0, maxit=3000, reltol=1e-10, MaxNWts=10000), fit all 7352 official training windows with public bounded transform; require convergence=0. Fit once per seed and reuse across epsilon. This is a window-trained central reference, not a subject-pooling-matched preprocessing twin.
trivial: Training-window majority class for accuracy; training-window class proportions for probabilities. No test prevalence used.
metrics: Window-level unweighted mean of six one-vs-rest rank AUCs with average ties; argmax accuracy with first-class tie break; natural-log multiclass log-loss with true-class probability floor1e-15. Gap is federated-DP minus central macro-AUC, sample SD across three replicate seeds on one fixed official split.
diagnostic: At epsilon8, mean accuracy strictly above training-majority predictor test accuracy AND mean macro-AUC >0.5. Disclose every replicate and whether all pass. No alternative after this one.
test_use: Train all three central and nine federated models without opening test members; training callback never forces its test promise. Create scoring marker, open official X_test/y_test/subject_test once in one final scoring run, then score each fitted model once. Never rerun a scored cell with changed settings.
failure_policy: Retain started run markers and any failure; no overwrite. Report whatever diagnostic outcome occurs.
